name: neo4j
description: Neo4j Cypher over the HTTP Query API v2: read queries (accessMode Read plus an agent statement guard), schema (labels, types, indexes, constraints), nodes by elementId; writes need an opt-in for agents, deletes are node only

nodes.title: Run read query
nodes.description: Run a read-only Cypher query (accessMode Read; agent statements with write clauses are refused); rows are in records, one object per row keyed by the RETURN names

statement.description: Cypher statement on one line; pass values as $name placeholders in parameters, never inline

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
